newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE nationals to hold 60 pct bank jobs in five years.
newsitem.headline: UAE nationals to hold 60 pct bank jobs in five years.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates wants its nationals to hold up to 60 percent of banking jobs in the next five years from a current 10 percent, newspapers said on Monday.

They quoted Minister of State for Finance and Industrial Affairs Ahmed bin Humaid al-Tayer as saying the decision to gradually increase the number of nationals employed by banks was taken after extensive study by a special state committee.
"Our aim is to increase the percentage of nationals working in banks to between 50 and 60 percent during the next five years," al-Bayan daily quoted Tayer as saying.
The UAE, like most Gulf Arab states, is trying to find more jobs for its citizens to reduce reliance on expatriate labour.
Foreign workers, mainly from the Indian subcontinent and southeast Asia, make up 75 to 80 percent of the 2.4 million-strong population.
There are 27 foreign banks, 15 representative offices and 19 local banks operating in the UAE.
